title: Current-Graph Lift of the 66 Bridge
orientation_rule: orient pair {i,j} as i->j when (j-i) mod 12 is in {1,2,3,4,5,6}; ties at distance 6 use smaller source
rotation_system: cyclic order around vertex i: i+1,i+2,...,i+11 mod 12
boundary: This is an abstract current-graph/rotation-system lift of K12 on genus 6. It does not assert a self-crossing-free Euclidean polyhedron realization.
